race.comment: BUNDY BELLE (6) went straight to the lead and was always in control last start in a maiden over this distance at Wyong. Has only faced the starter twice so there is plenty more to come. Should roll forward again and she looks ready to tackle this deeper field. THORSTEN (3) missed the frame for the first time this prep when a tiring fifth over 1100m at Scone last time out. Gets some weight relief today and coming back to 1000m looks a wise move. In the right race to bounce back to form. DIRTY SUMMER (2) has been freshened up since a luckless effort over this course and distance seven weeks back. Should be thereabouts. Ex Kiwi CONCORDE JET (4) resumes. Raced just once last prep back in April and wasn't disgraced. Hard mare to line up - keep a close watch on the betting.
